frozen_natural_result.parseability_caveat: The frozen 1/32 parseability and 0/8 informativeness results are confounded: the prompt required FINAL(...), while the scorer accepted only a bare list. Twenty replies used the requested wrapper. A descriptive envelope-unwrapping sensitivity gives 21/32 parseable, 10/32 all-verbatim, 7 nonzero rewards, and still 0/8 descriptive informative groups.
frozen_natural_result.interpretation: The clean finding is narrower: under the exact frozen policy+interface, the model used the root/IPython loop but did not spontaneously decompose any natural QASPER episode into an RLM child. That exact-interface child-density result is sufficient to make a branch-credit stock experiment infeasible. It is not evidence of inherent model incapacity, and the frozen parsing/reward counts are not independent scientific evidence.

forced_fixture_result.integration_error: The trace shows attempted direct top-level rlm tool calls returning Error: unknown tool 'rlm'; the installed RLM contract exposes rlm only as a callable inside IPython.
forced_fixture_result.interpretation: The fixture failed the child-invocation interface contract, so there was no recursive target. Exact-key replay rejected it before generating any alternative. This is an integration failure, not evidence that recursive credit is absent or incorrect; no paired cache/path or deterministic scorer-plumbing claim is made.

recommended_disposition: Do not spend additional GPU budget on this exact natural QASPER interface. Any successor must be a newly preregistered interface-feasibility experiment, not a retry: align the bare-list prompt and parser, make child invocation unambiguous by forcing await rlm(...) inside an IPython call (or exposing a real top-level tool), and require an end-to-end preflight that proves both contracts before live sampling.
